basis: V3 §3.5 / §10.20, Unity dyld blocked Framework reproduction

existingMechanisms.normalPermission: BGS preserves native stdio decisions; ordinary Bash allow is not OS filesystem grant
existingMechanisms.addDir: Native additionalDirectories is writable and overridden by launch deny-all filesystem; unsuitable for read-only tool installs
existingMechanisms.globalSettings: Trusted user settings remain loaded, but launch denyRead / uses flag allow-list; project settings/hooks remain disabled
existingMechanisms.unsandboxedFallback: Currently forbidden at project boundary; remains forbidden
existingMechanisms.mcp: External server processes/network and secrets are separate; read-only install grant does not certify MCP sandboxing

decision: One optional trusted host environment JSON mapping canonical workspace -> exact read-only tool paths. No new API, table, tool, planning stage, prompt or engine adapter.
trust: Read host process.env only, not selected model environment, brief, CLAUDE.md or project settings. Strip map from native child environment.
validation: Only matching workspace entry; reject malformed maps/entries, nonabsolute or noncanonical paths, links, missing paths and broad root/home/Applications or ancestors of the project/host. Validate before opening execution scratch. No auto-discovery/grants.
scope: Additional allowRead only; no extra allowWrite, Read auto-approval, hook/settings, network, PATH rewrite, runtime choice or non-sandbox execution.
sideEffects: Configured external install bytes become readable to commands in that explicit project, not just an engine binary.
Removing a grant affects next native launch; already running sandbox policy is immutable until normal exit; no active turn hot mutation.
CLI version success does not prove licensing/cache access, project editing/build/runtime, MCP isolation or full game delivery.
Canonical path checks do not authenticate publisher or eliminate privileged administrator/OS races; tool installs must be trusted.
simplerAlternativesRejected: Implicit installed-engine lookup assigns capabilities without authorization.
Global allowed tool roots expose unrelated projects.
--add-dir grants writes; unsandboxed approval removes project isolation.
Full per-engine roles/schema/authorization database not needed for proven read-only linker gap.
verification: Minimal red/green scope tests, actual macOS sandbox read/write/symlink tests, real native CLI with fixed loopback provider, and optional Unity read-only headless version in explicitly granted fixture; no license/config/project writes.
deployment: Implement only; do not edit production root env, restart active services or enable grants for real projects this turn.
